Maya (CS): OmniHealth pilot check-in notes 9/15. Capturing asks for product backlog. Please react with :+1: if you can own an item or comment ETA.
OmniHealth (customer): From our trial feedback:
- A: per-route spend breakdown in console (finance needs it to allocate product budgets)
- B: embeddings cache TTL control 9 we have periodic reindexes and results become inconsistent
- C: pin model family per-route 9 avoid accidental upgrades during trials
- D: a low-latency quantized preset for short completion SLOs (~100ms)
- E: more concrete Private deploy networking docs (we hit NAT/DNS hurdles)
- F: per-route rate-limit toggles so product teams can self-manage usage
Sam (PM): How urgent are these for renewal?
Maya (CS): A and D are must-haves for their renewal. B and E are medium priority. C and F are nice-to-have.
Lina (Eng): I'll take a look at D (quantized preset). Quick question for OmniHealth: typical sequence length?
OmniHealth (customer): usual queries ~400 tokens, batch ingests up to 1800.
Raj (ProductOps): I'll own A. Need the 30d billing CSV 9 OmniHealth can you share?
OmniHealth (customer): Uploaded: https://omni.s3/internal/omni-30d.csv
Sam (PM): Suggested triage: quick console toggle for F in 2 sprints; spike D; B is medium-term.
Lina (Eng): I can prototype quantized path this week 9 estimate 4d to get a perf baseline at 400/1800 seqs.
Maya (CS): Action items: @Raj owns A, @Lina take D spike, @Sam to add to roadmap, I'll draft renewal one-pager.
Sam (PM): Can we get a short customer quote for the renewal note?
OmniHealth (customer): Quote: 'Per-route cost visibility and a low-latency quantized option are blockers for scaling us past pilot.' Feel free to use.
Lina (Eng): Note: model pinning (C) might be possible with routing config; low lift. Example config: `route_overrides:
  - route: search
    pinned_model: redwood-v2-micro`
Maya (CS): Adding to CS tracker doc: https://doc.redwood/internal/cs/omni-pilot
SyncBot: Reminder 9 triage sync tomorrow 9am PT. Agenda: OmniHealth pilot items.
Sam (PM): Thanks everyone. React with :rocket: if you can help on the spike.
